title: hibiscus haenkeanus
intro: Hibiscus haenkeanus, commonly known as the Island Hibiscus, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing blood pressure, acting as a diuretic, and helping to alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes. The therapeutic actions of Hibiscus haenkeanus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-hypertensive properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which have been found to contribute to its medicinal properties.
